notablePrerequisites:
Sword of the Paruns attached to Warchanter Skald.
You control at least four additional Dwarf and/or Berserker creatures.
description:
Activate Sword of the Paruns by paying {3}, tapping Warchanter Skald.
Warchanter Skald triggers, creating a 2/1 Dwarf Berserker token.
Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Dwarf and/or Berserker creature you control.
Activate Sword of the Paruns by paying {3}, untapping Warchanter Skald.
Repeat.
